About MSC TERESA

MSC TERESA (IMO 9469560, MMSI 357891000) is a cargo ship (hazardous cargo A) registered in Panama. It is 366 m long and 51 m wide. Its most recent AIS position, received on 16 Nov 2026 at 13:56 UTC, placed it in the port of Kostrena, Croatia. The crew reported ITTRS as the destination.
